rationale: Second half of loancalculator.co.uk's register work: migration 699 (approved, corr 1f259a95) shipped 12 facts and `banned_claims: []`. The bugfix_414 lane's relay (2026-09-02) named the gap precisely: the site's `site_archetype.constraints` reads like a compliance layer in PROSE — 'Never make calculators appear to give regulated financial advice', 'Never add real lender recommendations or ranked product tables without FCA authorisation disclaimers', 'Never reposition the site as a lender or broker' — and nothing enforces it, while banned_claims patterns ARE enforced at the build gate, the persistence floor (claimsGuardBeforePersist refuses the save) and the post-deploy sweep. Migration 707 fills the array with EIGHT patterns: five adapted from adversecreditmortgage.co.uk's audited six (mortgage→loan), three translated from this site's own archetype constraints. The safety work is measurement, not judgement: (a) all eight compiled AND probe-fired through Go's own regexp engine 8/8 first — claims.go silently degrades a non-compiling pattern to a QuoteMeta literal, so an unverified pattern can be inert while looking armed; (b) every pattern censused against the FULL visible text of all 28 served pages: ZERO matches, so arming cannot refuse a save of any current page, including the pending bugs_open/397 GTM rerender wave; (c) the sibling set's literal-%APR pattern is EXCLUDED on a 2-match census — tools/compare-loans.html's deliberately illustrative '7.9% APR loan and an 8.4% APR loan' is the site's pedagogy, and adopting the ban would refuse a page for doing its educational job (RFC_060 §1c's false-positive class, measured here); (d) two lessons inherited from sibling migration 702 (loanzy, same day, same ask): the no-credit-check pattern is the NARROWED form targeting the lending PROMISE not the phrase (a calculator site truthfully says its own tools involve no credit check — loanzy measured that collision on their own copy; the narrowed form re-censused here separately since its hyphenated alternative is not a subset of the broad form: 0 matches, control fires), and the write is SUPERSEDE-AND-MERGE rather than an in-place jsonb_set — the daily refresher's write-back is a CAS keyed on the row id it read (writeRefreshedEvidenceBase), so an in-place edit between its read and write is silently restored to [] (a lost update); the supersede changes the row id, the refresher affects 0 rows and skips, and idx_site_specs_current backstops any concurrent writer.

plan.summary: One data migration (707): supersede-and-merge loancalculator.co.uk's current evidence_base row, carrying all 12 facts (and their 2 corrects_site_citation fields, asserted in the verify) unchanged while filling banned_claims with 8 patterns — 5 adapted from the audited sibling set, one of them narrowed per 702's measured lesson, 3 translated from the site's own archetype constraints; the sibling's literal-%APR pattern excluded on a 2-match census of live copy. All patterns Go-compiled and probe-fired 8/8; all censused at zero matches across all 28 served pages. Guard aborts unless exactly one current register with 12 facts and empty banned_claims exists; verify is DO/RAISE asserting 8 patterns with substantive reasons, 12 surviving facts, and the 2 surviving correction fields. Rollback sidecar uses the same supersede shape.

edits.rationale: The enforcement translation the 414 lane asked for, with every pattern's admission decided by measurement: Go-engine compile+probe (8/8, because claims.go's QuoteMeta fallback makes a broken pattern silently inert), zero-match census over all 28 served pages (so no current page and no pending rerender wave can be refused), the literal-APR exclusion measured at 2 matches on illustrative pedagogy, and the no-credit-check narrowing inherited from 702's measured collision. Supersede-and-merge because the refresher's CAS makes in-place register edits losable; pinned carried from the superseded row; created_by hands to this migration (699's rollback guard then refuses, correctly, per its own header).
edits.sketch: WITH cur AS (UPDATE site_specs SET is_current=false, superseded_at=now() WHERE site_id='0162cde4-…' AND aspect='evidence_base' AND is_current RETURNING data, pinned) INSERT INTO site_specs (…) SELECT …, jsonb_set(cur.data, '{banned_claims}', '[ {"pattern": "\\bguaranteed (acceptance|approval|loans?|yes)\\b", "reason": "…census 2026-09-02"}, … \\bno[- ]credit[- ]check (loans?|lending|borrowing)\\b|… (NARROWED per 702), … we (recommend|advise) (that )?you (take out|borrow|apply) (archetype: no regulated advice), … (we lend|borrow from us|apply (with|through) us|…) (archetype: not a lender/broker), … (best|top) (uk )?(loan|lender|deal)s? (archetype: no ranked recommendations) ]'::jsonb), 'manual', NULL, 'loancalculator_couk lane (migration 707)', true, cur.pinned, '…' FROM cur; -- verify: 1 current row, 12 facts, 8 patterns each with pattern>10 & reason>20 chars, 2 corrects_site_citation fields surviving

grounded_in: bugfix_414 lane relay, 2026-09-02: 'Your site_archetype.constraints already reads like a compliance layer, in prose … Nothing enforces any of that. It is agent-written prose in a doc no gate reads. Several of those are one translation away from banned_claims patterns, which are enforced.'

Census [MEASURED 2026-09-02], full visible text of all 28 served pages: P1-P5, P7-P9 (the eight shipped) = 0 matches each; the sibling's literal-APR pattern = 2 matches, both tools/compare-loans.html: 'a 7.9% APR loan and an 8.4% APR loan can be compared like for like' — illustrative pedagogy, not a price promotion.

Go-engine verification, 2026-09-02: regexp.Compile("(?i)"+p) succeeded for all 8 and each fired on its planted probe — run because datahelpers/claims.go:346-349 falls back to QuoteMeta on compile failure, turning a broken regex into a silently inert literal.

Sibling migration 702 (loanzy, same day): the narrowed no-credit-check form and its reason ('loanzy''s calculator truthfully says no credit check involved about its own tool - the ban targets the lending promise, not the phrase'), and the supersede-and-merge shape with idx_site_specs_current as the race backstop.

refresh_evidence_base_action.go writeRefreshedEvidenceBase (:1440-1500): the CAS supersede is keyed on the row id read moments earlier — the mechanism that makes an in-place register edit a lost update and the supersede shape the safe one (verified this session for the 699 round's advisory, corr 1f259a95).
adversecreditmortgage.co.uk's live banned_claims (read from the DB this session): the six audited patterns and reasons this set adapts.
plan.risks: 1) Live the moment it applies; rollback sidecar (same supersede shape) restores banned_claims: [] while carrying facts. 2) The patterns refuse FUTURE copy that matches: that is the design, and the zero-match census bounds the blast radius to genuinely new copy; the negation guard (negatedClaimMatch) additionally protects educational discussion of the banned phrases, and cmd/claimscan diffs guard-on vs guard-off so suppression is visible. 3) The narrowed no-credit-check form deliberately does NOT ban the bare phrase 'no credit checks' — a page could still say it about a LOAN in words the narrow form misses; accepted per 702's measured trade (the broad form would permanently refuse a calculator site's honest self-description; first-findings review after arming is the standing instruction from the 414 relay). 4) created_by hands from 699 to 707, so 699's rollback guard refuses from now on — correct and documented in both headers. 5) A refresher pass or a concurrent register writer during apply: the supersede-and-merge either wins cleanly or aborts on the unique partial index / 0-row supersede; re-run after reading. 6) Council timing: applied on the owner's standing direction for this register work (the 414 relay is its continuation) with the verdict read when it lands — same sequencing as 699, whose verdict was APPROVED.
